title: Estimating heterogeneous survival treatment effects of lung cancer screening approaches: A causal machine learning analysis.
summary: In 53,454 participants, the paper reported no statistically significant overall lung-cancer or overall-mortality benefit, while describing exploratory subgroup patterns. The subgroup patterns are exploratory retrospective causal-inference estimates, not confirmed treatment effects or prospective screening benefit.
ai_technology: AFT-BART estimated censored survival counterfactuals from National Lung Screening Trial data, and a tree summarized heterogeneous subgroup treatment-effect estimates.
